race.comment: Veteran ARCHDEACON (6) has won just three races from 73 starts but his last effort was an eye-opener, coming from last at one stage to be beaten narrowly over 1350m at Strathalbyn. Won't find this as tough and over the slightly longer journey he could make a rare visit to the winner's circle. MAGIC PRINCESS (4) will be hard to beat after her respectable sixth first-up over 1200m at Strathalbyn. Has two wins and three placings at today's trip so expect her to improve with that run under the belt. ARTPARK (1) had a six-week let-up before his last run, a closing fifth over a similar distance to this at Hamilton. Has won here before and should prove tough to stop with that last run tightening him right up. DODGY ELEMENT (8) returned from a one-month let-up with a far better performance last time out, beaten under two lengths over 1200m at Strathalbyn. Suited by the extra 230m and should be thereabouts. LYSANDER (5) is finding it hard to win but recent efforts have been sound.
